content: Debian manpages systemd-analyze(1): verify FILE loads unit files and prints warnings for unknown directives missing deps missing docs/executables; unit filename must carry unit suffix else Failed to prepare filename Invalid argument (alias via colon supported); without --recursive-errors=MODE added v250 verify returns exit 0 regardless of warnings; with --recursive-errors=yes non-zero on warnings. Source: https://manpages.debian.org/stable/systemd/systemd-analyze.1.en.html
